subject.facility_name: PINES AT BRISTOL FOR NURSING & REHABILITATION, THE

executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $184.49 per resident day (42.2% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was -0.5% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $281,173, 3.4% of the $8,374,014 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $1,307,943, $28.82 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $635,084 (48.6%), allocated fringe $196,461 (15.0%), non-wage costs $476,398 (36.4%). Raw food was $391,792 ($8.63 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61) and purchased dietary services $34,521.
Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost $595,439, $13.12 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.32). Wages $426,098 (71.6%), allocated fringe $131,812 (22.1%), non-wage costs $37,529 (6.3%).
Cost year 2025: laundry cost $272,498, $6.0 per resident day (Connecticut median $5.66). Wages $41,429 (15.2%), allocated fringe $12,816 (4.7%), non-wage costs $218,253 (80.1%).
Missing data: cost years 2019, 2021 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

The filing is still listed in financials.json.

Cost year 2021 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (direct care per resident day outside the plausible range; nursing hours per resident day outside the plausible range; direct care share of expenses outside the plausible range; core figures (days, revenue or expenses) could not be read; payer days do not add up to the printed total; revenue lines do not add up to the printed total). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
